local delayTime = 1
local pattern = "_"

local function sendChatMessage(msg)

        TextChatService.TextChannels.RBXGeneral:SendAsync(msg)

end

local tmxMessages = {
    "CLAN ON TOP 🔥", "FYTER BNEGA? 🤣", "MEH FIRE 🔥",

    "MEH TIGER", "LION", "EAGLE",
    "MEH SHARK", "GHOST", "MASTER"
}

local function generateLine()
    if pattern == "" then pattern = "_" end
    local result = ""
    while #result < 150 do
        result = result .. pattern
    end
    return string.sub(result, 1, 150)
end

local function startTMXSpam()
    if saying then return end
    saying = true
    sendChatMessage(targetName .. " SPAMMER STARTED 👑")
    task.wait(0.1)
    
    spamThread = task.spawn(function()
        while saying do
            local randomMsg = tmxMessages[math.random(1, #tmxMessages)]
            -- Ab target name sirf ek hi baar aayega format ke mutabiq: [TargetName] + Message
            local msg = generateLine().."\n"..targetName.." "..randomMsg
            sendChatMessage(msg)
            task.wait(math.max(delayTime, 0.2))
        end
    end)
end

local function stopAll()
    saying = false
    if spamThread then
        task.cancel(spamThread)
        spamThread = nil
    end
    sendChatMessage("SPAMMER STOPPED 🛑")
end

-- ===== GUI =====

gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true

titleText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
titleText.TextSize = 22
titleText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 20, 20)

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", mainFrame)
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center

local function createInput(placeholder, text, order)
    local container = Instance.new("Frame", mainFrame)
    container.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 35)
    container.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 20, 20)
    container.LayoutOrder = order
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", container)
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", container)
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 10, 10)
    stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    local input = Instance.new("TextBox", container)
    input.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
    input.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    input.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    input.Text = text
    input.PlaceholderText = placeholder
    input.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    input.TextSize = 14
    input.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
    input.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
    input.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    container.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 0, 0)}):Play()
    end)
    container.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(stroke, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 10, 10)}):Play()
    end)
    return input
end

local function createButton(text, color, order)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", mainFrame)
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 40)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = color
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 15
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.LayoutOrder = order
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    local darkenColor = Color3.new(color.R * 0.7, color.G * 0.7, color.B * 0.7)
    local lightenColor = Color3.new(math.min(color.R * 1.2, 1), math.min(color.G * 1.2, 1), math.min(color.B * 1.2, 1))
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = lightenColor}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundColor3 = color}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = darkenColor}):Play()
    end)
    btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {BackgroundColor3 = lightenColor}):Play()
    end)
    return btn
end

titleSpacer.LayoutOrder = 0

local stopBtn = createButton("STOP", Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40), 5)

toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -25)

toggleBtn.Text = "TMX"
toggleBtn.TextSize = 15
toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 20, 20)
toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggleBtn.Visible = true
toggleBtn.Draggable = true

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", toggleBtn)
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
local toggleStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", toggleBtn)
toggleStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
toggleStroke.Thickness = 2

-- ===== INPUT HANDLING =====
targetInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local text = targetInput.Text
    if text ~= "" then 
        targetName = "[" .. text .. "]"
    else
        targetName = "[TARGET]"
    end
end)

delayInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local num = tonumber(delayInput.Text)
    if num and num > 0 then 
        delayTime = num 
    else 
        delayInput.Text = tostring(delayTime) 
    end
end)

patternInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    if patternInput.Text ~= "" then 
        pattern = patternInput.Text 
    end
end)

startBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startTMXSpam)
stopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(stopAll)

local menuOpen = true
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    menuOpen = not menuOpen
    if menuOpen then
        mainFrame.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 290)}):Play()

        closeTween:Play()
        closeTween.Completed:Wait()
        mainFrame.Visible = false
    end
end)

local function FindEPrompt(Character)

	if not Character then

	end

	for _, Object in ipairs(
		Character:GetDescendants()
	) do

		if Object:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			and Object.Enabled
			and Object.KeyboardKeyCode ==
				Enum.KeyCode.E
		then

			return Object

		end
	end

	return nil

--========================================================

local function FindDownedPlayer()

	local MyCharacter, MyRoot =
		GetCharacter()

	if not MyRoot then
		return nil
	end

	local ClosestPlayer = nil
	local ClosestDistance = math.huge

	for _, Target in ipairs(
		Players:GetPlayers()
	) do

		if Target ~= Player then

			local Character =
				Target.Character

			if Character
				and IsDowned(Character)
			then

				local Root =
					Character:
					FindFirstChild(
						"HumanoidRootPart"
					)

				if Root then

					local Distance =
						(
							Root.Position -
							MyRoot.Position
						).Magnitude

					if Distance <
						ClosestDistance
					then

						ClosestDistance =
							Distance

						ClosestPlayer =
							Target

					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return ClosestPlayer

	end

scripts.script:
-- ==========================================
-- 1. RE-EXECUTION CLEANUP & STATE STORAGE
-- ==========================================
if _G.UniversalHubCleanup then
    pcall(_G.UniversalHubCleanup)
end

local connections = {}
local activeLoops = {true}

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

_G.OriginalLighting = _G.OriginalLighting or {
    Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
    Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
    GlobalShadows = true,
    FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
    FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
}

_G.OriginalGravity = workspace.Gravity
_G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom = LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance
_G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

Lighting.GlobalShadows = true

-- Spectate Tracer Cleanup Variables
local spectateBeam = nil
local spectateAtt0 = nil
local spectateAtt1 = nil

local function removeSpectateTracer()
    if spectateBeam then pcall(function() spectateBeam:Destroy() end) spectateBeam = nil end
    if spectateAtt0 then pcall(function() spectateAtt0:Destroy() end) spectateAtt0 = nil end
    if spectateAtt1 then pcall(function() spectateAtt1:Destroy() end) spectateAtt1 = nil end
end

-- Custom Highlight & Billboard Containers Cleanup
local customHighlightFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
customHighlightFolder.Name = "UniversalHub_CustomHighlights"
customHighlightFolder.Parent = workspace

local playerHighlights = {}
local npcHighlights = {}

local function clearAllCustomHighlights()
    if customHighlightFolder then
        customHighlightFolder:ClearAllChildren()
    end
    table.clear(playerHighlights)
    table.clear(npcHighlights)
end

_G.UniversalHubCleanup = function()
    activeLoops[1] = false
    
    for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
        if conn and conn.Connected then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    table.clear(connections)

    removeSpectateTracer()
    clearAllCustomHighlights()
    if customHighlightFolder then customHighlightFolder:Destroy() end

    if workspace:FindFirstChild("UniversalFloatPlatform") then
        workspace.UniversalFloatPlatform:Destroy()
    end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam and LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hum then
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        elseif hrp then
            cam.CameraSubject = hrp
        end
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end

    if _G.OriginalLighting then
        Lighting.Brightness = _G.OriginalLighting.Brightness
        Lighting.Ambient = _G.OriginalLighting.Ambient
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = _G.OriginalLighting.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.FogEnd = _G.OriginalLighting.FogEnd
        Lighting.FogStart = _G.OriginalLighting.FogStart
    end

    workspace.Gravity = _G.OriginalGravity
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight
    LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom

    if _G.FluentWindow then
        pcall(function() _G.FluentWindow:Destroy() end)
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 2. EXECUTOR TIER & ENVIRONMENT DETECTION
-- ==========================================
local executorName = "Unknown"
local executorVersion = "Unknown"

pcall(function()
    if identifyexecutor then
        executorName, executorVersion = identifyexecutor()
    elseif getexecutorname then
        executorName = getexecutorname()
    end
end)

local lowerExecutorName = string.lower(executorName)
local isLowLevelExecutor = (
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "xeno") or 
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "delta") or 
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "hydrogen") or
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "fluxus")
)

print("[FluentHeart]: Detected Executor -> " .. executorName .. " | Mode: " .. (isLowLevelExecutor and "Low-Level Compatibility Mode" or "Standard/Medium Mode"))

-- ==========================================
-- 3. SERVICES & CORE VARIABLES
-- ==========================================
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")

local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

-- Settings & Flags
local walkSpeedValue = 16
local jumpPowerValue = 50
local fovValue = 70

local customCameraZoomEnabled = false
local customCameraZoomValue = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom

local tpToolEnabled = false
local floatEnabled = false
local qeControlEnabled = true
local floatSpeedValue = 42
local floatBaseY = nil
local floatYOffset = -2

local potatoGraphicsEnabled = false
local fullbrightEnabled = false
local noFogEnabled = false

local customGravityEnabled = false
local customGravityValue = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity)
local disableSlidingEnabled = false
local instantAirControlEnabled = false

local joinLogEnabled = false
local playerJoinTimes = {}

local lowHpTrackerEnabled = false
local deathListenerEnabled = false
local deathLogs = {}
local lowHpDebounce = {}

local spectatingPlayer = nil
local selectedTpPlayer = nil
local spawnCFrame = nil

-- Sound Configuration System
local soundSettings = {
    LowHP = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://4590657391" },
    PlayerLeft = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://9114220737" },
    General = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://9060817403" }
}

local function playCustomSound(category)
    pcall(function()
        local cfg = soundSettings[category] or soundSettings.General
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.SoundId = cfg.SoundId
        sound.Volume = cfg.Volume
        sound.Parent = SoundService
        sound:Play()
        game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound, 3)
    end)
end

local function recordSpawnLocation(char)
    local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    if hrp then
        task.wait(0.2)
        spawnCFrame = hrp.CFrame
    end
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    task.spawn(recordSpawnLocation, LocalPlayer.Character)
end
table.insert(connections, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(recordSpawnLocation))

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    playerJoinTimes[player] = tick()
end

table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    playerJoinTimes[player] = tick()
end))

local originalMaterials = {}
task.spawn(function()
    local parts = Workspace:GetDescendants()
    local yieldLimit = isLowLevelExecutor and 100 or 250
    for i = 1, #parts do
        local part = parts[i]
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            originalMaterials[part] = part.Material
        end
        if i % yieldLimit == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
end)

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
        originalMaterials[part] = part.Material
        if potatoGraphicsEnabled then
            part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        end
    end
end))

-- ==========================================
-- 4. HELPER FUNCTIONS & LOGIC
-- ==========================================

local function giveTeleportTool()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not backpack then return end

    if backpack:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") or char:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") then return end

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "Teleport Tool"
    tool.RequiresHandle = false

    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and Mouse.Hit then
            local currentRotation = hrp.CFrame - hrp.CFrame.Position
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * currentRotation
        end
    end)

    tool.Parent = backpack
end

local floatPlatform = nil
local function updateFloatPlatform(dt)
    if not floatEnabled then
        if floatPlatform then
            floatPlatform:Destroy()
            floatPlatform = nil
        end
        floatBaseY = nil
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hrp and hum then
        local hipOffset = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) and (hum.HipHeight + 1.2) or 3.0
        local targetY = hrp.Position.Y - hipOffset

        if not floatBaseY then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        if math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 15 then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        if hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
            if targetY > floatBaseY and (targetY - floatBaseY) < 12 then
                floatBaseY = targetY
            end
        else
            if math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 0.5 then
                floatBaseY = targetY
            end
        end

        local verticalSpeed = floatSpeedValue * dt
        if qeControlEnabled then
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY + verticalSpeed
            elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY - verticalSpeed
            end
        end

        if not floatPlatform or not floatPlatform.Parent then
            floatPlatform = Instance.new("Part")
            floatPlatform.Name = "UniversalFloatPlatform"
            floatPlatform.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
            floatPlatform.Anchored = true
            floatPlatform.CanCollide = true
            floatPlatform.Transparency = 0.9
            floatPlatform.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
            floatPlatform.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
            floatPlatform.Parent = Workspace
        end
        
        local finalY = floatBaseY + floatYOffset
        floatPlatform.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, finalY, hrp.Position.Z)
    end
end

local function isCharacterPart(part)
    local ancestor = part.Parent
    while ancestor and ancestor ~= Workspace do
        if ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            return true
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function stopSpectating()
    spectatingPlayer = nil
    removeSpectateTracer()

    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if cam and char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        if hum then
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        elseif hrp then
            cam.CameraSubject = hrp
        end
        
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end
end

local function updateSpectateTracer()
    if not spectatingPlayer or not spectatingPlayer.Character or not LocalPlayer.Character then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        return
    end

    local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHRP = spectatingPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not myHRP or not targetHRP then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        return
    end

    if not spectateBeam or not spectateBeam.Parent then
        spectateAtt0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        spectateAtt0.Name = "SpectateAtt0"
        spectateAtt0.Parent = myHRP

        spectateAtt1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        spectateAtt1.Name = "SpectateAtt1"
        spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP

        spectateBeam = Instance.new("Beam")
        spectateBeam.Name = "SpectateTracer"
        spectateBeam.Attachment0 = spectateAtt0
        spectateBeam.Attachment1 = spectateAtt1
        spectateBeam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        spectateBeam.Width0 = 0.05
        spectateBeam.Width1 = 0.05
        spectateBeam.FaceCamera = true
        spectateBeam.LightEmission = 1
        spectateBeam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
        spectateBeam.Parent = myHRP
    else
        if spectateAtt0 and spectateAtt0.Parent ~= myHRP then spectateAtt0.Parent = myHRP end
        if spectateAtt1 and spectateAtt1.Parent ~= targetHRP then spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP end
    end
end

                    Duration = 4
                })

                table.insert(deathLogs, 1, {
                    name = player.Name,
                    cframe = deathCF,
                    label = label
                })

                if #deathLogs > 200 then
                    table.remove(deathLogs)
                end

                local labels = {}
                for _, entry in ipairs(deathLogs) do
                    table.insert(labels, entry.label)
                end
                deathDropdown:SetValues(labels)
            end
        end))
    end

    if player.Character then onCharacter(player.Character) end
    table.insert(connections, player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter))

            if hl then hl:Destroy() end
        end
        table.clear(activePathHighlights)

        local function evaluateAndHighlight(str)
            if not str or str == "" then return end
            pcall(function()
                local fn = loadstring("return " .. str)
                if fn then
                    local res = fn()
                    local targets = {}
                    if typeof(res) == "Instance" then
                        table.insert(targets, res)
                    elseif type(res) == "table" then
                        for _, item in pairs(res) do
                            if typeof(item) == "Instance" then
                                table.insert(targets, item)
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                        if target:IsA("BasePart") or target:IsA("Model") then
                            local partToCheck = target:IsA("Model") and target.PrimaryPart or target
                            if partToCheck and myHRP then

                                    highlight.Parent = customHighlightFolder

crosshair.Name = "ShiftLockCrosshair"
crosshair.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
crosshair.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
crosshair.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
crosshair.BackgroundTransparency = 1
crosshair.Image = "rbxasset://textures/MouseLockedCursor.png"
crosshair.Visible = false
crosshair.Parent = screenGui

-- Textures
local TEXTURE_OFF = "rbxasset://textures/ui/mouseLock_off.png"
local TEXTURE_ON = "rbxasset://textures/ui/mouseLock_on.png"

local isShiftLocked = false

-- Toggle function
local function setShiftLock(enabled)
	isShiftLocked = enabled
	
	if isShiftLocked then
		shiftButton.Image = TEXTURE_ON
		crosshair.Visible = true
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	else
		shiftButton.Image = TEXTURE_OFF
		crosshair.Visible = false
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	end
end

-- Render loop for Camera & Character behavior
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local character = LocalPlayer.Character
	if not character then return end
	
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	
	if isShiftLocked and humanoid and rootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		
		-- Rotate player to face camera direction
		local cameraCFrame = Camera.CFrame
		local lookVector = Vector3.new(cameraCFrame.LookVector.X, 0, cameraCFrame.LookVector.Z)
		if lookVector.Magnitude > 0 then
			rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(rootPart.Position, rootPart.Position + lookVector)
		end
		
		-- Shoulder camera offset
		Camera.CFrame = cameraCFrame * CFrame.new(1.75, 0.5, 0)

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then ctrl.f = 1 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then ctrl.b = -1 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then ctrl.l = -1 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then ctrl.r = 1 end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.W then ctrl.f = 0 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.S then ctrl.b = 0 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.A then ctrl.l = 0 end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.D then ctrl.r = 0 end
end)

-- Sistema estável de braços fechados
local function setArmsClosed(character)
    if not character then return end
    local ls = character:FindFirstChild("LeftShoulder", true) or character:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder", true)
    local rs = character:FindFirstChild("RightShoulder", true) or character:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder", true)
    if ls and rs then
        ls.Transform = CFrame.new(-0.2, -0.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-5))
        rs.Transform = CFrame.new(0.2, -0.2, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(5))
    end
end

-- Motor Principal de Voo 3D Livre Relativo à Câmera
local function startFly()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    local hrp = character.HumanoidRootPart
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.PlatformStand = true
    end
    
    -- Inicializa instâncias físicas estáveis
    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bg.P = 9e4
    bg.cframe = hrp.CFrame
    bg.Parent = hrp
    
    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bv.Parent = hrp
    
    -- Vincula o voo ao ciclo de renderização físico estável do Roblox
    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
        
        setArmsClosed(character)
        bg.cframe = Camera.CFrame
        
        -- Se houver movimento nas teclas W,A,S,D calcula vetor 3D perfeito pela mira
        if ctrl.f + ctrl.b ~= 0 or ctrl.l + ctrl.r ~= 0 then
            bv.velocity = ((Camera.CFrame.LookVector * (ctrl.f + ctrl.b)) + (Camera.CFrame.RightVector * (ctrl.l + ctrl.r))).Unit * flySpeed
        else
            bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end
        
        -- Injeção Física Direta contra Dano de Queda (Bypass NDS Completo)
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
            pcall(function()
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = bv.velocity
            end)
        end
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() flyConnection = nil end
    if bg then bg:Destroy() end
    if bv then bv:Destroy() end
    
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character then
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
            humanoid.SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, true)
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
        end
        local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) end
    end
end

-- Alternar Estado
local function toggleFly()
    flying = not flying
    if flying then
        ToggleButton.Text = "LIGADO (E)"
        ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 175, 105) -- Verde moderno
        startFly()
    else
        ToggleButton.Text = "DESLIGADO (E)"

        stopFly()
    end
end

end)
